name: Iraq National Data Center / National Cloud Facility
developer: Government of Iraq / General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers
notes: Government facility inaugurated Aug 2023 by PM Al-Sudani at the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers; first phase included National Cloud Facility installation. Capacity not disclosed. PMO/Cabinet page would be A when accessible; DCD/IBN are B. Not commercial colocation.

name: MoC/Nokia state-owned commercial data centers (Al Intisar and Al-Rashid/Al-Sinak exchanges)
developer: Iraq Ministry of Communications / GCCI / Nokia
notes: Contract stage as of Sep 2025 for two state-owned data centers in Baghdad, one at Al Intisar exchange and one at Al Rasheed exchange in Al-Sinak district, for government and private-sector customers. IBN cites MoC (B+); do not mark operational without launch/site-work evidence.

name: T964 / Tech964 Tier III colocation data center
notes: Official site (checked 2026-08-12) markets 'Iraq's AI-Ready Infrastructure Platform': Tier III colocation, 99.99% uptime claim, carrier-neutral, N+1 full redundancy, 24/7 NOC/SOC, claims Uptime-certified design/construction/operation (operator claim). DCD reports construction for launch end-2026, 3 MW IT load (operator claim) and 12 MW scalable phase capacity/340 racks phase 1; site power access claim 84 MW. Uptime Institute named T964 its business partner in Iraq (signed at US-Iraq Business Summit, Jul 2026). Status construction per DCD; capacity_mw recorded as stated 3 MW IT load, other figures in notes.

name: Ministry of Planning census data center (Nokia-built)
notes: Mentioned in Nokia/MoC coverage as a prior Nokia-built data center supporting the 2024 national census; exact site and current status unverified. Candidate only - requires Ministry of Planning or Nokia primary confirmation before counting as facility.

name: Legacy Baghdad data centers (GCCIT / Alamiya / Talia)
developer: GCCIT (General Company for Communications and Informatics), Alamiya Co, Talia
notes: DCD citing Data Center Journal reports three data centers in Baghdad run by GCCIT, Alamiya Co and Talia. Legacy directory leads only; may be stale. Promote only with current official/operator evidence.

name: KRG Government Data Center
developer: Kurdistan Regional Government / Department of Information Technology
notes: KRG opened Tier III-based government data center (Erbil area) early Sep 2022; KRG states capacity around 320 kW and intended to host/digitalize 300+ government services. KRG official page A; DCD/IBN B. Government facility, not commercial colo.

name: Linkdata Erbil DC 1
notes: Linkdata official/blog pages claim the only Tier 3 cloud compute provider and data center in Kurdistan (operator claim, A for existence); Kurdistan24 (B) describes its Erbil data center running 24/7 services; DataCenterMap (C) places it near Erbil at 100m Road, Peshawa Qazi. Capacity/MW not disclosed; Tier claim is operator self-disclosure.

name: Asiacell Erbil Data Center - 2
notes: Uptime Institute awards listing identifies Asiacell as client for 'Erbil Data Center - 2' in Erbil, Iraq - official certification/awards page confirms facility existence. Capacity and award dates not visible in crawled text. Telco core facility.

name: Maysan Oil Company modular data center
developer: Maysan Oil Company / Smart Oasis / CNOOC / Huawei
notes: RAS/Smart Oasis reported successful Factory Acceptance Test at Huawei factories for the Maysan Oil Company modular data center project with CNOOC. Equipment-award/build phase = under construction; oil-sector facility, capacity not disclosed.

name: Nineveh Governorate - Uptime Institute digital infrastructure partnership
notes: MOU signed Jul 17 2026 at the US-Iraq Business Summit to advance data centre standards/digital infrastructure in Nineveh. No named facility, site or capacity disclosed - program-level planned record, not a built datacenter.

name: Zain Iraq Al-Diwaniyah Tier III data center infrastructure
notes: IPT PowerTech/Zain Iraq LinkedIn post says IPT delivered Tier III data center infrastructure for Zain Iraq in Al-Diwaniyah for digital/AI workloads. Social-source evidence only; capacity not published. Telco core facility, C grade pending operator/primary confirmation.

name: Tikrit University centralized institutional data center
developer: Tikrit University / Simmons University / IREX / U.S. Department of State
notes: IREX/US State Dept grant to help Tikrit University establish a centralized institutional data center for data and research. Likely university server/repository environment rather than commercial colocation; no completion or capacity found.
